paper_title: Randomized Open-Label Pilot Study of the Influence of Probiotics and the Gut Microbiome on Toxic Metal Levels in Tanzanian Pregnant Women and School Children

pico.intervention: locally produced yogurt including Lactobacillus rhamnosus GR-1
pico.comparison: ultra-heat-treated milk devoid of lactic acid bacteria
pico.outcome: Elevated blood lead was associated with increases in Succinivibrionaceae and Gammaproteobacteria relative abundance levels in stool.

n.group_name: locally produced yogurt including Lactobacillus rhamnosus GR-1
ultra-heat-treated milk devoid of lactic acid bacteria

supplement: pilot study. Pregnant women in the same environment were given similar interventions and assessed by blood metal levels.
